SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, COALESCE(pending.pending_approval_id, appr.route_approval_id) AS electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(pending.pending_ea_exe_id, appr.route_ea_exe_id, '') AS ea_exe_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pending.pending_title), ''), '') AS title, t.tenant_code, g.cata_code, g.cata_name AS category_name, COALESCE(g.view_seq, 0) AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term, COALESCE(cci.item_nm, w.reg_term) AS reg_term_nm, CASE WHEN w.expiration_apply = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS expiration_apply, CASE WHEN w.use_at = 'Y' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS active, COALESCE(pending.pending_drafter_name, pending.pending_login_code, CAST(pending.pending_login_id AS varchar), '-') AS created_by, CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.assignee_count, 0) = 0 THEN '-' WHEN wa.assignee_count = 1 THEN wa.first_assignee_name ELSE wa.first_assignee_name || ' 외 ' || CAST(wa.assignee_count - 1 AS varchar) || '명' END AS owner, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE 'DRAFT' END AS todo_status, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 'in_progress' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 'approved' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 'rejected' ELSE NULL END AS approval_status_type, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN '결재진행중' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN '승인' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN '임시저장' WHEN COALESCE(appr.latest_status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN '반려' ELSE '미작성' END AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(COALESCE(pending.pending_arrival_at, appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at, CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) AS template_json, w.drafting_work_template_html AS template_html, CASE WHEN w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.total_count, 0) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS written_in_cycle, COALESCE(pending.pending_alert, FALSE) AS pending_approval_alert, TO_CHAR(pending.pending_arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS pending_arrival_at, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(rpt.max_report_date, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS last_report_date, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(rev_u.user_nm), ''), '-') AS reviewer_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(apr_u.user_nm), ''), '-') AS approver_name, COALESCE(rpt.last_writer_name, '-') AS last_writer_name, CASE WHEN cyc.is_anytime THEN NULL ELSE TO_CHAR(cyc.cur_start + cyc.cycle_step - INTERVAL '1 day', 'YYYYMMDD') END AS cycle_end_date, COALESCE(uw.unwritten_count, 0) AS unwritten_count, COALESCE(uw.in_progress_cycle_count, 0) AS in_progress_cycle_count, COALESCE(uw.approved_cycle_count, 0) AS approved_cycle_count, COALESCE(uw.rejected_cycle_count, 0) AS rejected_cycle_count FROM tb_drafting_work_category w JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ccg ON ccg.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ccg.group_code = 'WF_FORM_CYCLE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item cci ON cci.group_id = ccg.common_code_group_id AND cci.item_code = w.reg_term LEFT JOIN tb_user rev_u ON rev_u.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND rev_u.login_id = w.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN tb_user apr_u ON apr_u.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND apr_u.login_id = w.approver_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT u.cycle_unit, u.is_anytime, u.cycle_step, CASE WHEN u.cycle_unit = 'half' THEN date_trunc('year', LOCALTIMESTAMP) + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM LOCALTIMESTAMP) >= 7 THEN INTERVAL '6 months' ELSE INTERVAL '0 months' END ELSE date_trunc(u.cycle_unit, LOCALTIMESTAMP) END AS cur_start, CASE WHEN u.cycle_unit = 'half' THEN date_trunc('year', CAST(COALESCE(t.service_start_date, DATE(t.created_at)) AS timestamp)) + CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM COALESCE(t.service_start_date, DATE(t.created_at))) >= 7 THEN INTERVAL '6 months' ELSE INTERVAL '0 months' END ELSE date_trunc(u.cycle_unit, CAST(COALESCE(t.service_start_date, DATE(t.created_at)) AS timestamp)) END AS first_start FROM ( SELECT k.cycle_unit, k.is_anytime, CASE k.cycle_unit WHEN 'month' THEN INTERVAL '1 month' WHEN 'week' THEN INTERVAL '1 week' WHEN 'quarter' THEN INTERVAL '3 months' WHEN 'half' THEN INTERVAL '6 months' WHEN 'year' THEN INTERVAL '1 year' ELSE INTERVAL '1 day' END AS cycle_step FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('월', '매월', 'month', 'MONTH', 'monthly', 'MONTHLY') THEN 'month' WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('주', '매주', 'week', 'WEEK', 'weekly', 'WEEKLY') THEN 'week' WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') = 'QUARTER' THEN 'quarter' WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') = 'HALF' THEN 'half' WHEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') = 'YEAR' THEN 'year' ELSE 'day' END AS cycle_unit, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(w.reg_term), ''), '') IN ('수시', 'ANYTIME', 'anytime') AS is_anytime ) k ) u ) cyc ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignee_count, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id ))[1] AS first_assignee_name FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a LEFT JOIN tb_user um ON um.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ( CAST(um.user_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no OR CAST(um.login_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no ) WHERE a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) wa ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.electronic_approval_id AS pending_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') AS pending_ea_exe_id, m.ea_title AS pending_title, m.login_id AS pending_login_id, la.login_code AS pending_login_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar)) AS pending_drafter_name, MAX(li.arrival_at) AS pending_arrival_at, TRUE AS pending_alert FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m JOIN tb_electronic_approval_line_info li ON li.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND li.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id LEFT JOIN tb_user pu ON pu.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND pu.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_id = m.login_id WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND li.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND li.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND li.exe_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' GROUP BY m.electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, ''), m.ea_title, m.login_id, la.login_code, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar)) ORDER BY MAX(li.arrival_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) pending ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
WITH cycle_base AS ( SELECT cyc.cur_start AS cycle_start, cyc.cur_start + cyc.cycle_step AS cycle_end ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'pre_apply' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pre_apply_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_count, MAX(COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at)) AS latest_updated_at, ( ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(m.status_type, '') ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS latest_status_type, ( ARRAY_AGG(m.electronic_approval_id ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS route_approval_id ,( ARRAY_AGG(COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') ORDER BY COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC) )[1] AS route_ea_exe_id FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m CROSS JOIN cycle_base cb WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id
AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND m.report_date >= TO_CHAR(cb.cycle_start, 'YYYYMMDD') AND m.report_date < TO_CHAR(cb.cycle_end, 'YYYYMMDD') ) appr ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT m.report_date AS max_report_date, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(wu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(wla.login_code), ''), '-') AS last_writer_name FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m LEFT JOIN tb_user wu ON wu.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND wu.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account wla ON wla.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND wla.login_id = m.login_id WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND m.report_date ~ '^[0-9]{8}$' ORDER BY m.report_date DESC, COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) rpt ON TRUE LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.status_type IS NULL)::int AS unwritten_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.status_type = 'in_progress')::int AS in_progress_cycle_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.status_type = 'approved')::int AS approved_cycle_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ls.status_type = 'rejected')::int AS rejected_cycle_count FROM ( SELECT cs.status_type FROM ( SELECT wd.work_date AS p_start, wd.work_date + 1 AS p_end FROM tb_workdate wd WHERE cyc.cycle_unit = 'day' AND wd.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND wd.work_type IN ('WORK', 'SPECIAL_WORK') AND wd.work_date >= CAST(cyc.first_start AS date) AND wd.work_date <= CURRENT_DATE UNION ALL SELECT wk.from_date, wk.to_date + 1 FROM tb_week wk WHERE cyc.cycle_unit = 'week' AND wk.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND wk.to_date >= CAST(cyc.first_start AS date) AND wk.from_date <= CURRENT_DATE UNION ALL SELECT CAST(gs.cycle_start AS date), CAST(gs.cycle_start + cyc.cycle_step AS date) FROM generate_series(cyc.first_start, cyc.cur_start, cyc.cycle_step) AS gs(cycle_start) WHERE cyc.cycle_unit NOT IN ('day', 'week') ) p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(em.status_type, '') AS status_type FROM tb_electronic_approval_main em WHERE em.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND em.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(em.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(em.status_type, '') != 'pre_apply' AND em.report_date >= TO_CHAR(p.p_start, 'YYYYMMDD') AND em.report_date < TO_CHAR(p.p_end, 'YYYYMMDD') ORDER BY COALESCE(em.updated_at, em.created_at) DESC, em.electronic_approval_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) cs ON TRUE WHERE NOT cyc.is_anytime AND COALESCE(w.expiration_apply, 'N') != 'Y' UNION ALL
SELECT CASE WHEN es.status_type = 'approved' THEN NULL ELSE es.status_type END FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.equipment_id, COALESCE(s.material_type, ''), s.certification_user_id) COALESCE(xm.status_type, '') AS status_type, s.expiration_date FROM tb_electronic_approval_sub s JOIN tb_electronic_approval_main xm ON xm.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND xm.electronic_approval_id = s.electronic_approval_id WHERE w.expiration_apply = 'Y' AND s.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND xm.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(xm.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(xm.status_type, '') != 'pre_apply' ORDER BY s.equipment_id, COALESCE(s.material_type, ''), s.certification_user_id, s.inspected_date DESC, xm.electronic_approval_id DESC ) es ) ls ) uw ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND w.use_at = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) ORDER BY COALESCE(appr.latest_updated_at, w.updated_at, w.created_at) DESC, w.drafting_work_category_id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.drafting_work_category_id, m.report_date, CASE WHEN w.expiration_apply = 'Y' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END) CAST(m.drafting_work_category_id AS varchar) AS "workId", m.report_date AS "cycleDate", CAST(m.electronic_approval_id AS varchar) AS "approvalId", COALESCE(m.status_type, '') AS "statusType", TO_CHAR(m.created_at, 'YYYYMMDD') AS "registeredDate", COALESCE(m.ea_title, '') AS "title", COALESCE(e.equip_nm, u.user_nm, '') AS "targetName", COALESCE(s.material_type, '') AS "materialType" FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category w ON w.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id LEFT JOIN tb_electronic_approval_sub s ON s.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND s.electronic_approval_id = m.electronic_approval_id LEFT JOIN tb_equipment_info e ON e.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND e.equipment_id = s.equipment_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u.user_id = s.certification_user_id WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.drafting_work_category_id IS NOT NULL
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND m.report_date BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY m.drafting_work_category_id, m.report_date, CASE WHEN w.expiration_apply = 'Y' THEN m.electronic_approval_id END, COALESCE(m.updated_at, m.created_at) DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC

SELECT latest.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (m.drafting_work_category_id, s.equipment_id, COALESCE(s.material_type, ''), s.certification_user_id) CAST(m.drafting_work_category_id AS varchar) AS "workId", CAST(m.electronic_approval_id AS varchar) AS "approvalId", s.expiration_date AS "expirationDate", CAST(s.equipment_id AS varchar) AS "equipmentId", COALESCE(s.material_type, '') AS "materialType", CAST(s.certification_user_id AS varchar) AS "certificationUserId", COALESCE(e.equip_nm, u.user_nm, '') AS "targetName" FROM tb_electronic_approval_sub s JOIN tb_electronic_approval_main m ON m.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND m.electronic_approval_id = s.electronic_approval_id LEFT JOIN tb_equipment_info e ON e.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND e.equipment_id = s.equipment_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND u.user_id = s.certification_user_id WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) ) AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND m.status_type = 'approved' ORDER BY m.drafting_work_category_id, s.equipment_id, COALESCE(s.material_type, ''), s.certification_user_id, s.inspected_date DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC ) latest WHERE latest."expirationDate" BETWEEN #{fromDate} AND #{toDate} ORDER BY latest."expirationDate", latest."approvalId"
SELECT TO_CHAR(COALESCE(t.service_start_date, DATE(t.created_at)), 'YYYYMMDD') FROM tb_tenant t WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS total_todo_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS active_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS draft_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(appr.in_progress_count, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(appr.approved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::int AS today_action_count, 0::int AS notice_count FROM tb_drafting_work_category w LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in_progress_count, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'approved' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved_count FROM tb_electronic_approval_main m WHERE m.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND m.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) appr ON TRUE WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a2 WHERE a2.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a2.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a2.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a2.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND ( (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = CAST(#{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AS varchar)) OR (#{actorUserId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL AND #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND a2.employee_no = #{actorLoginCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ) )

SELECT w.drafting_work_category_id, m.electronic_approval_id, COALESCE(m.ea_exe_id, '') AS ea_exe_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(m.ea_title), ''), '') AS title, t.tenant_code, g.cata_code, g.cata_name AS category_name, COALESCE(g.view_seq, 0) AS category_sort_order, w.cata_type_code, w.code_name, w.reg_term,
COALESCE(cci.item_nm, w.reg_term) AS reg_term_nm, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pu.user_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(la.login_code), ''), CAST(m.login_id AS varchar), '-') AS created_by,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(wa.assignee_count, 0) = 0 THEN '-' WHEN wa.assignee_count = 1 THEN wa.first_assignee_name ELSE wa.first_assignee_name || ' 외 ' || CAST(wa.assignee_count - 1 AS varchar) || '명' END AS owner, 'IN_PROGRESS' AS todo_status, 'in_progress' AS approval_status_type,
'결재진행중' AS approval_status_type_name, TO_CHAR(li.arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS latest_status_at, CAST(w.drafting_work_template_json AS text) AS template_json, w.drafting_work_template_html AS template_html, CASE WHEN w.drafting_work_template_json IS NOT NULL OR NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(w.drafting_work_template_html, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS has_document, TRUE AS written_in_cycle, TRUE AS pending_approval_alert, TO_CHAR(li.arrival_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS pending_arrival_at FROM tb_electronic_approval_line_info li JOIN tb_electronic_approval_main m ON m.tenant_id = li.tenant_id AND m.electronic_approval_id = li.electronic_approval_id JOIN tb_drafting_work_category w ON w.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND w.drafting_work_category_id = m.drafting_work_category_id JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_drafting_work_category_group g ON g.drafting_work_category_group_id = w.drafting_work_category_group_id AND g.tenant_id = w.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ccg ON ccg.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND ccg.group_code = 'WF_FORM_CYCLE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item cci ON cci.group_id = ccg.common_code_group_id AND cci.item_code = w.reg_term
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS assignee_count, (ARRAY_AGG( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(um.user_nm), ''), a.employee_no) ORDER BY a.drafting_work_category_authority_id ))[1] AS first_assignee_name FROM tb_drafting_work_category_authority a LEFT JOIN tb_user um ON um.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND ( CAST(um.user_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no OR CAST(um.login_id AS varchar) = a.employee_no ) WHERE a.tenant_id = w.tenant_id AND a.drafting_work_category_id = w.drafting_work_category_id AND a.use_at = 'Y' AND COALESCE(a.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ) wa ON TRUE LEFT JOIN tb_user pu ON pu.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND pu.login_id = m.login_id LEFT JOIN tb_login_account la ON la.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND la.login_id = m.login_id WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NOT NULL AND li.login_id = #{actorLoginId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND li.arrival_at IS NOT NULL AND li.exe_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(li.muldec_status, '') = 'drafted' AND COALESCE(m.status_type, '') = 'in_progress' AND COALESCE(m.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(w.delete_status, 'N') != 'Y' ORDER BY li.arrival_at DESC, m.electronic_approval_id DESC
